verdict.rationale: Pika's Talking Head Video app documents adding a script and choosing a presenter to make a virtual spokesperson, which covers script-to-video with a stock avatar and no camera. The custom-avatar path is documented only as 'use your own image and audio', and lip sync likewise starts from uploaded audio, so a custom avatar driven directly from a pasted script is not shown. Missing for 10: documented script-to-speech for a custom avatar (the custom path requires your own audio), any description of the stock presenter library's breadth or quality, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor claims.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio

citations.quote: Add a script and choose a presenter, or use your own image and audio for explainers, demos and video messages.
Talking Head Video: Make a virtual spokesperson
Upload an image and speech, music or a voice recording to create an animated performance with AI lip sync.
